judged_text: The only spec for the new Admin::EmbeddingController asserts subclass-ness, leaving the show serialization contract — root 'embedding' with embeddable_host_ids plus the side-loaded records that the new store plural-ids hydration consumes — untested. adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new admin embedding model/serializer flow that depends on a specific JSON contract: `EmbeddingSerializer` uses `has_many :embeddable_hosts, ... embed: :ids` (app/serializers/embedding_serializer.rb) and the client store was extended to hydrate plural `*_ids` into pluralized associations (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6, regex `/(.+)\_id(s?)$/` + `obj[self.pluralize(subType)] = ...`). However, the only new controller specs for `Admin::EmbeddingController` and `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` merely assert subclassing and do not assert the `show` payload shape (root `embedding`, presence of `embeddable_host_ids`, and side-loaded `embeddable_hosts`). While there are store tests added for generic plural-id hydration (`color_ids` in fruit), there is no end-to-end or serializer/controller spec to catch a regression specific to `/admin/customize/embedding` payload generation that could cause the admin embedding page to render no hosts.
